data: Which of the following has the highest concreteness score in figure 2?

The scatter plot shows three groups of poems: 19th century, Imagist, and contemporary. The y-axis represents concreteness scores, while the x-axis represents publication years. The data points are color-coded according to the group they belong to. The highest concreteness scores are observed in the Imagist group, which are represented by triangles. Therefore, among the three groups, the Imagist poems have the highest concreteness scores.
